question: Who has been appointed as the new Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) of India in February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gyanesh Kumar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Gyanesh Kumar has been appointed as the new Chief Election Commissioner, replacing Rajiv Kumar.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gyanesh Kumar is a 1988-batch IAS officer from the Kerala cadre, and he replaces Rajiv Kumar as the Chief Election Commissioner.**
 
• The appointment was made following a selection process involving Prime Minister Narendra Modi and other senior leaders.
 
• This is the first appointment of the CEC under the Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioner Act, 2023.
 
• Gyanesh Kumar's appointment follows the retirement of Rajiv Kumar, who led the Commission from May 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Chief Election Commissioner (CEC)__

 __
 
• The CEC is the head of the Election Commission of India, overseeing the administration and conduct of elections in the country.
 
• The CEC is appointed for a fixed tenure and plays a crucial role in ensuring free and fair elections.
 
 
 
• Election Commissioner__
 __
 
• Election Commissioners work alongside the CEC and help manage the electoral process, with a focus on policy, planning, and execution.
 
• The Election Commission is a constitutional body tasked with administering elections in India at the central and state levels.
 
 
 
• Rajiv Kumar__
 __
 
• Rajiv Kumar served as the 25th CEC and oversaw key elections including the 2024 Lok Sabha elections.
 
• He was credited for implementing reforms and ensuring peaceful elections during his tenure.
 
 
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioner Act, 2023__
 
 
• This Act outlines the process of appointing and managing Election Commissioners and the CEC, ensuring an independent and impartial electoral body.
